relationships.subject: Jak1/Jak2 inhibitor
relationships.evidence_quote: Recent findings from a Phase 3 clinical trial showed that patients with RA who were treated with a Janus kinase 1 (Jak1) and Janus kinase 2 (Jak2) inhibitor achieved significantly greater improvements in pain than those treated with a tumor necrosis factor blocker

relationships.subject: Jak/STAT pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: consistent with the overarching involvement of the Jak-signal transducer and activator of transcription (Jak/STAT) pathway in mediating the action, expression, and regulation of a multitude of pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokines

key_findings: A Phase 3 trial reported greater pain improvement in RA with a Jak1/Jak2 inhibitor than with a TNF blocker despite similar inflammation markers.
Jak/STAT-regulated cytokines contribute to multiple pain mechanisms in RA.
